_comment: OPTIONAL. Models billed at different peak/off-peak prices (e.g. DeepSeek) are
reported at the price actually charged when this file exists. Rates themselves
stay in config/model_pricing.json and are treated as the BASE (peak) rates; this
file only says WHEN a window applies and how it scales those rates.
Copy this file to config/peak_rates.json and edit it. Without that file the
built-in defaults in src/utils/peak_rates.py apply, and any provider not listed
here is billed flat. The file is read at startup, so restart the bot after editing.
Each provider entry is merged over its built-in default, so list only what changes.
Times are UTC. 'days' accepts single names or inclusive ranges: ["mon-fri"],
